t4.titulo: How to avoid mistakes with false friends
t4.descripcion:
🔹 TIPS TO AVOID MISTAKES (consejos para evitar errores):

1. LEARN THE MOST COMMON ONES:
   Focus on the false friends that appear most frequently (actual, asistir, constipado, embarazada, éxito, librería, sensible, sopa).

2. CONTEXT IS KEY:
   Context will help you know if you have understood correctly.
   Example: If someone says "Estoy constipado" and sneezes, it means they have a cold.

3. ASK IF YOU HAVE DOUBTS:
   "¿Quieres decir...?" or "¿Significa esto...?"

4. READ IN CONTEXT:
   Reading authentic texts will help you become familiar with the real use of these words.

5. USE A DICTIONARY:
   When you are not sure, consult a bilingual dictionary.

📌 USEFUL PHRASES TO ASK:
• ¿Quieres decir...? = Do you mean...?
• ¿Eso significa...? = Does that mean...?
• En inglés, esta palabra significa..., ¿en español es igual? = In English, this word means..., is it the same in Spanish?

❌ COMMON MISTAKES YOU SHOULD AVOID:
• Saying "estoy embarazada" when you mean "estoy avergonzada".
• Saying "asistir a alguien" when you mean "ayudar a alguien".
• Looking for a "librería" when you want a "biblioteca".
ejemplos: En inglés 'library' es biblioteca, no librería.
Si dices 'estoy embarazada', pensarán que esperas un bebé.

t1.descripcion:
Words that look like English but have a different meaning:

🔹 A-B:
• actual ≠ actual (real)
  actual = current / present
  Example: El presidente actual es muy popular.

• asistir ≠ to assist
  asistir = to attend
  Example: Voy a asistir a la reunión.

• billón ≠ billion
  billón = trillion (1.000.000.000.000)
  Example: La deuda es de un billón de dólares.

🔹 C-D:
• carpeta ≠ carpet
  carpeta = folder
  Example: Guarda los papeles en la carpeta.

• constipado ≠ constipated
  constipado = to have a cold
  Example: Estoy constipado, tengo que descansar.

• decepción ≠ deception
  decepción = disappointment
  Example: Fue una gran decepción.

• delito ≠ delight
  delito = crime
  Example: Cometió un delito grave.

🔹 E-G:
• embarazada ≠ embarrassed
  embarazada = pregnant
  Example: Mi hermana está embarazada.

• éxito ≠ exit
  éxito = success
  Example: Tuvo mucho éxito en su carrera.

• fábrica ≠ fabric
  fábrica = factory
  Example: Trabaja en una fábrica.

• ganga ≠ gang
  ganga = bargain
  Example: Compré esta chaqueta por una ganga.

🔹 I-L:
• introducir ≠ to introduce (people)
  introducir = to insert / to introduce (objects)
  Example: Introduce el disco en la computadora.

• largo ≠ large
  largo = long
  Example: El río es muy largo.

• librería ≠ library
  librería = bookstore
  Example: Compro libros en la librería.

📌 EXAMPLES:
• No confundas 'librería' con 'biblioteca'.
• Recuerda que 'éxito' no es 'exit'.
• Si dices 'estoy embarazada', pensarán que estás esperando un bebé.
ejemplos: Si dices 'estoy embarazada', pensarán que estás esperando un bebé.

t3.descripcion:
🔹 FALSE FRIENDS TABLE (False friends table):

| Español | Significado real | Inglés similar | Significado del inglés |
|---------|------------------|----------------|------------------------|
| actual | current/present | actual | real |
| asistir | to attend | to assist | ayudar |
| carpeta | folder | carpet | alfombra |
| constipado | to have a cold | constipated | estreñido |
| embarazada | pregnant | embarrassed | avergonzado |
| éxito | success | exit | salida |
| fábrica | factory | fabric | tela |
| ganga | bargain | gang | pandilla |
| introducir | to insert | to introduce | presentar |
| largo | long | large | grande |
| librería | bookstore | library | biblioteca |
| molestar | to bother | to molest | abusar |
| once | eleven | once | una vez |
| preservativo | condom | preservative | conservante |
| profesor | teacher | professor | catedrático |
| realizar | to carry out | to realize | darse cuenta |
| recordar | to remember | to record | grabar |
| ropa | clothes | rope | cuerda |
| sano | healthy | sane | cuerdo |
| sensible | sensitive | sensible | sensato |
| sopa | soup | soap | jabón |
| suceso | event | success | éxito |

📌 TRICK TO REMEMBER:
When you see a word in Spanish that looks like English, ask: "Does it make sense in this context?" If not, it's probably a false friend.
ejemplos: When you see 'actual', think of 'current', not 'real'.

t2.descripcion:
🔹 M-O:
• molestar ≠ to molest
  molestar = to bother
  Example: No me molestes mientras estudio.

• nota ≠ note
  nota = grade / mark (also note)
  Example: Saqué buena nota en el examen.

• once ≠ once (one time)
  once = eleven
  Example: Son las once de la mañana.

🔹 P-R:
• pretender ≠ to pretend
  pretender = to intend / to claim
  Example: Pretendo viajar el año que viene.

• preservativo ≠ preservative
  preservativo = condom
  Example: Es importante usar preservativo.

• profesor ≠ professor
  profesor = teacher (any level)
  Example: Mi profesor de español es muy bueno.

• realizar ≠ to realize
  realizar = to carry out / to achieve
  Example: Realicé mis sueños.

• recordar ≠ to record
  recordar = to remember
  Example: No recuerdo su nombre.

• ropa ≠ rope
  ropa = clothes
  Example: Voy a comprar ropa nueva.

🔹 S-Z:
• sano ≠ sane
  sano = healthy
  Example: Comer fruta es sano.

• sensible ≠ sensible
  sensible = sensitive
  Example: Es una persona muy sensible.

• sopa ≠ soap
  sopa = soup
  Example: Me gusta la sopa de verduras.

• suceso ≠ success
  suceso = event / happening
  Example: Fue un suceso histórico.

• tener ≠ to tener (does not exist)
  tener = to have
  Example: Tengo un libro.

📌 EXAMPLES:
• No digas 'estoy constipado' si tienes fiebre.
• Recuerda que 'sensible' no es 'sensible' en inglés.
• 'Realizar' no es 'to realize', es 'to carry out'.
ejemplos: No digas 'estoy constipado' si tienes fiebre.
Recuerda que 'sensible' no es 'sensible' en inglés.

dict.当我到达马德里时，我的西班牙语相当不错，但假朋友总是让我出丑。有一天，我想说我对: When I arrived in Madrid, my Spanish was quite good, but false friends always made me embarrass myself. One day, I wanted to say I was excited about a project (embarazada actually means pregnant), but I said 'I am pregnant', and everyone looked at me in surprise. Another day, in a bookstore, I asked for a folder (carpeta), and the clerk took me to the stationery section, not the books section. I also remember inviting a friend to attend (asistir) a lecture; he thought I was going to help, but I meant to attend. I learned that words like 'actual' (meaning 'current', not 'actual') or 'largo' (meaning 'long', not 'large') can cause misunderstandings. Now, when I have doubts, I ask or check the dictionary. Prevention is better than regret.
dict.当这个人说“estoy embarazada”时，她本来想说什么？: When the person said 'estoy embarazada', what did she originally want to say?
dict.原文说“queriendo decir que estaba embarazad: The original text says 'queriendo decir que estaba embarazada de un proyecto', meaning she wanted to express excitement about a project but misused embarazada (pregnant).
dict.原文说“pregunté por una carpeta y el librer: The original text says 'pregunté por una carpeta y el librero me llevó a la sección de papelería', because carpeta is a folder, not a book.
dict.根据课文，'actual' 是什么意思？: According to the text, what does 'actual' mean?
dict.原文明确说“'actual' (que significa 'presente': The original text explicitly says "'actual' (que significa 'presente', no 'actual')", so actual means 'current'.
dict.这个人为了避免误解做了什么？: What did the person do to avoid misunderstandings?
dict.原文最后说“cuando tengo dudas, pregunto o bus: The original text finally says 'cuando tengo dudas, pregunto o busco en el diccionario'.
dict.西班牙语日常生活中的假朋友: False friends in everyday Spanish life
dict.在西班牙和拉丁美洲，假朋友是轶事的常见来源。例如，一个英国游客可能点“torti: In Spain and Latin America, false friends are a common source of anecdotes. For example, an English tourist might order 'tortilla' expecting a potato omelette, but in Mexico, tortilla is a thin corn flatbread. Another classic example is 'coger' (to take), which is normal in Spain but has sexual connotations in some Latin American countries. Talking about a project with 'embarazada' also sounds strange. Native Spanish speakers usually laugh affectionately at these mistakes, and learning them is part of the experience of learning Spanish.
dict.在中文里，我们也有类似的情况，比如“方便”在不同语境下意思不同，或者“意思”一词: In Chinese, we also have similar situations, such as '方便' having different meanings in different contexts, or the word '意思' being polysemous. Similar to Spanish false friends, both need to be understood according to context.
dict.是形容词“当前的”，不能直接作表语表示“目前”；应使用副词 actualment: It is the adjective 'current' and cannot be used directly as a predicate to mean 'currently'; the adverb actualmente should be used.
dict.表示“参加”时是不及物动词，需要加介词 a，并与冠词缩合为 al。: When meaning 'to attend', it is an intransitive verb and requires the preposition a, which contracts with the article to al.
dict.是文件夹，不是书架或书柜；如果指书柜应用 estantería。: It is a folder, not a bookshelf or bookcase; if referring to a bookcase, estantería should be used.
dict.是“敏感的”，但形容人容易哭应用 sensiblero（多愁善感的）。: It means 'sensitive', but to describe someone who cries easily, sensiblero (sentimental) should be used.
dict.是“实现、进行”，不是“意识到”；“意识到”用 darse cuenta。: It means 'to carry out, to do', not 'to realize'; 'to realize' is darse cuenta.
dict.我不是怀孕了，我只是想说我有一个人令人兴奋的项目。: I am not pregnant, I just wanted to say I have an exciting project.

dict.街上的噪音让我很烦。: The noise from the street annoys me.
dict.这件衬衫真是便宜货：只花了十欧元。: This shirt is a real bargain: it only cost ten euros.
dict.派对成功的关键是音乐。: The key to a successful party is music.
dict.别忘了把卡插入取款机。: Don't forget to insert the card into the ATM.
dict.汉语母语者常把西班牙语的 r 和 rr 发成汉语的“l”或“r”音。发 r（如: Native Chinese speakers often pronounce Spanish r and rr as the Chinese 'l' or 'r' sounds. When pronouncing r (as in pero), the tip of the tongue taps the alveolar ridge once; when pronouncing rr (as in perro), the tip of the tongue vibrates rapidly multiple times. You can practice word contrasts: pero/perro, caro/carro, ahora/ahorra.
